done_when: The review fingerprint also covers every file a finding of the earlier review cites, so a commit that changes such a file (even under plans/) makes the next close review the new head instead of reusing the old result. A command-level test closes a fix whose review cites plans/roadmap.json, changes that file, closes again, and shows a fresh review ran.
why: Close reuses an earlier review after a new commit fixes a finding in a file the review fingerprint ignores (such as plans/roadmap.json), so the stale finding is shown again and has to be dismissed as already resolved
